forwardings.description: List of port forwarding rules in the format port:host:hostport (resembles ssh -L). Each item is a flat map with keys: port, host, host_port.

forwardings.items.description: Structure of each item in forwardings list. FLAT map fields: port (string), host (string), host_port (string). Note: 'type' for items is conceptually object, but per schema rules, we define the flat fields below as if they were direct keys in a hypothetical object, but since 'items' must be a FLAT map field-name -> schema, we use the 'items' key to define the shape. However, the prompt says 'add items as a FLAT map'. So 'items' is a dict of {field_name: {type, default, desc}}.

forwardings.items.port.description: Local TCP port to bind for forwarding.

forwardings.items.host.description: Destination host on the VPN side.

forwardings.items.host_port.description: Destination port on the VPN side.

dynamic_port.description: Port to start SOCKS5 server on. If provided, -D is added.

dynfw_bind_address.description: Bind address for the dynamic forwarding socket.

allow_remote.description: If true, binds local sockets to 0.0.0.0 instead of 127.0.0.1 (-g).

keepalive.description: Interval in seconds to send TCP keepalive packets (-k).

tcpdump.description: Write log of TCP/UDP packets to /tmp/tcpdump (-T).

domain.description: Override default DNS domain for unqualified hostnames (-o).
